meta.name: Indian Game Show
meta.description: The Indian Game Show is a high-energy comedy game show created and hosted by Bharti Singh and Haarsh Limbachiyaa. Featuring popular television actors, choreographers, musicians, and social media influencers, contestants face off in physical stunts, comedy challenges, and quirky tasks to win prizes while avoiding hilarious punishments

videos.title: Grand Premiere: The Fun Begins
videos.overview: The Indian Game Show is a high-energy comedy game show created and hosted by Bharti Singh and Haarsh Limbachiyaa. Featuring popular television actors, choreographers, musicians, and social media influencers, contestants face off in physical stunts, comedy challenges, and quirky tasks to win prizes while avoiding hilarious punishments

videos.title: The Celebrity Face-Off
videos.overview: Aly Goni, Jasmin Bhasin, and Priyank Sharma join Bharti and Haarsh to tackle slippery obstacle challenges and test their quick reflexes in comedy games.

videos.title: Dancers on the Floor
videos.overview: Renowned choreographers and TV personalities compete in dizzying coordination games, dance dares, and tricky physical tasks.

videos.title: Double Trouble
videos.overview: Popular television duos pair up to navigate tricky team challenges, testing their coordination and comedy timing under timed penalties.

videos.title: The Influencer Clash
videos.overview: Leading digital creators and social media stars face hilarious obstacle courses and fast-paced buzzer rounds hosted by Bharti and Haarsh.

videos.title: Khatron Ke Khiladi Special
videos.overview: Punit Pathak, Varun Sood, and Vishal Singh enter the arena to test their speed, balance, and comedic endurance against tricky traps.

videos.title: Comedy Champions
videos.overview: Stand-up comedians and TV actors team up for messy food tasks, slapstick obstacle tracks, and rapid-fire quiz punishments.

videos.title: The Star Showdown
videos.overview: Maniesh Paul, Aditya Narayan, and Aamir Ali join the fun, engaging in banter with Bharti and Haarsh while competing in physical game challenges.

videos.title: Television Stars Arena
videos.overview: Karan Patel, Vishal Pandey, and Arti Singh take on the obstacle floor in a series of balancing acts and comedy rounds.

videos.title: Musical Mayhem
videos.overview: Playback singers and music composers face off in musical dares, buzzer challenges, and silly penalties.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Contestants cross slippery stone bridges carrying balls. Puneet J. Pathak wins with superior balance.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Contestants answer MCQs; wrong answers lead to a water fall. Aly Goni wins.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Pairs catch and score balls while balancing and moving. Karanvir Bohra and Teejay Sidhu’s team wins.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Tic-Tac-Toe-inspired team challenge with strategy and blocking. Team winning most rounds wins.

videos.title: A Star-Studded Start
videos.overview: The Indian Game Show kicks off with Jannat Zubair, Abhishek Kumar, Tony Kakkar, Chandan Prabhakar, Karan Patel, and Anita Hassanandani facing thrilling challenges and fun-filled games hosted by Bharti Singh and Haarsh Limbachiyaa.

videos.title: Celebrities Battle It Out
videos.overview: The Indian Game Show heats up as contestants face thrilling games and unexpected challenges. Who will outsmart their rivals and claim the ultimate victory?

videos.title: The Ultimate Pair Battle
videos.overview: Indian Game Show heats up as three pairs compete in thrilling challenges. Who will outplay the competition and claim the ultimate victory?

videos.title: Level Up The Challenge
videos.overview: Indian Game Show levels up the excitement as contestants face tougher challenges at every stage. Who will rise above the competition?

videos.title: Rakhi Special Game Challenge
videos.overview: Indian Game Show brings a Raksha Bandhan special with fun, Rakhi themed games and exciting challenges. Who will rise to the occasion and win?

videos.title: Double The Fun
videos.overview: Prince-Manisha, Jannat-Abhishek and Karan-Deepika bring fresh energy, fun and excitement, taking the entertainment to another level.

videos.title: Horror Special
videos.overview: A horror special takes over the Indian game show as contestants face spooky challenges, scary surprises and thrilling games.

videos.title: Mukke Pe Mukka
videos.overview: Mukke Pe Mukka brings contestants face-to-face with spooky challenges, unexpected surprises and thrilling games in an entertaining battle of fun.

videos.title: Construction Special Challenge
videos.overview: In this Construction Special, contestants tackle exciting themed games filled with fun, quirky challenges and surprises.

videos.title: Level Up The Splash
videos.overview: Jannat, Abhishek, Karan and Dipika face thrilling water-themed challenges. As the levels rise, can they adapt and emerge victorious?

videos.title: Janmashtami Games Special
videos.overview: The Indian Game Show celebrates Janmashtami with fun-filled games, festive challenges and exciting moments as contestants compete for victory.

videos.title: Teachers' Day Special
videos.overview: The Indian Game Show celebrates Teachers' Day with fun-filled games, exciting challenges, and heartwarming moments as contestants compete for victory.

videos.title: Pizza Parlour Challenge
videos.overview: Contestants take on a pizza parlour themed game filled with exciting challenges as they try to overcome the hurdles and emerge victorious.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Contestants take on exciting games and fun challenges on Indian Game Show, bringing entertainment, laughter, and thrilling moments.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: In this Maha Episode of Indian Game Show, find out who amongst Mannara-Karan, Akanksha-Abhishek and Manisha-Prince takes home the win.

videos.title: Fresh Talent Takes Center Stage
videos.overview: Indian Game Show welcomes new contestants Faisal and Archana as they take on fun and exciting challenges.

videos.title: Neena And Arjun Join The Fun
videos.overview: Neena Gupta and Arjun Bijlani make a special appearance on Indian Game Show, adding fun and excitement to the episode with their presence.

videos.title: Treadmill Challenge Begins
videos.overview: The treadmill game kicks off on Indian Game Show as Archana, Prince, and Himanshi step into the first round, bringing energy, fun, and excitement to the competition.

videos.title: The Bowl And Ball Challenge
videos.overview: Contestants balance water-filled bowls on their shoulders and transfer them into buckets kept across the pool while dodging a giant ball.

videos.title: The Blumber Wall Challenge
videos.overview: Prince and Abhishek take on the Blumber Wall Challenge in the first round, bringing energy, fun, and excitement to the competition with their entertaining antics.

videos.title: The Zorb Ball Challenge
videos.overview: Team Bharti and Team Harssh face off in the exciting Zorb Ball Challenge, delivering nonstop fun, thrilling moments, and plenty of entertainment. Who will win the battle?

videos.title: Wobbly Tic Tac Toe Showdown
videos.overview: Balancing skills and quick thinking are put to the test as the teams face the Wobbly Tic Tac Toe Challenge, packed with fun, chaos, and entertainment!

videos.title: Harssh Ke Hathode vs Bharti Ke Bulldozer
videos.overview: Get ready for double the fun when Harssh Ke Hathode and Bharti Ke Bulldozer face off in a thrilling battle of wit, teamwork, and entertainment.

videos.title: The Slippery Water Challenge
videos.overview: Get ready for a fun-filled challenge where contestants must slip, slide, and race their way to bring the water without spilling it.

videos.title: The Ultimate Conveyor Basketball Challenge
videos.overview: Three contestants race on a moving conveyor belt in quirky costumes, aiming to score baskets while tackling fun challenges and testing their skills.

videos.title: Jaa Simran Jaa With A Twist
videos.overview: Contestants gear up for the Jaa Simran Jaa challenge with their partners, only to be caught off guard by a surprising twist.

videos.title: Slide Tambola Challenge
videos.overview: Contestants take on a fun-filled Slide Tambola challenge, bringing excitement, laughter, and a competitive twist to the game.

videos.title: The Floating Mat Challenge
videos.overview: Contestants must make their way across a mat floating on a water pool and place rings on a board at the other end to complete the challenge.

videos.title: The Ultimate Music Challenge
videos.overview: Contestants take on a musical challenge inside a cage, where each song guess determines who takes the plunge into the pool.

videos.title: The Glass Pyramid Challenge
videos.overview: Suspended in the air, a contestant stacks glasses to build a pyramid with teammates' support. Amid fun, excitement and teamwork, which team will win?

videos.title: The Great Balloon Blast
videos.overview: layers in balloon suits hang in the air as teammates guide them. They must burst rivals' balloons in a fun-filled game to release ping-pong balls.

videos.title: Zorb Ball Showdown
videos.overview: Contestants race ahead in giant zorb balls on a slippery track. When the music stops, they must freeze instantly or face point deductions.

videos.title: The Pillar Knockdown
videos.overview: A player rolls inside a giant zorb ball as teammate push it towards the target. Which team will topple the most pillars and roll its way to victory?

videos.title: X-O Board Battle
videos.overview: Contestants race to grab hanging Xs and Os, cross obstacles, and place them on the board. Who will complete a winning row first?

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: One player hangs high on a harness with a giant ball while their partner guides them from below. Can they land enough shots in the buckets to win?

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: New challengers step into the game alongside Karan Veer Mehra, Pratik Sehajpal and Akanksha Chamola. Can the newcomers outshine the competition?

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Contestants swing into action as they use their feet to launch balls into rotating baskets in a challenge built on precision and timing.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Dressed as honey bees, contestants swing on ropes to burst balloons before facing a tricky quiz, where wrong answers send them splashing into water.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: From balancing stacked suitcases to matching grandmothers with their grandchildren, the contestants face tough tests. Who will win?

videos.title: Ready, Set, Search!
videos.overview: With a festive Navratri twist, contestants tackle a lively challenge that puts their speed, wit and observation skills to the test. Who will excel?

videos.title: Jump, Swing, Score
videos.overview: One partner bounces to collect hanging balls and passes them to a teammate swinging in the air, who aims for the right courts to score points.
